source_conflict.summary: Official and aggregate status signals are aligned.

official.summary: Epic Games Statuspage API: All Systems Operational

updates.title: Epic Games Statuspage API: All Systems Operational
V-Bucks Delivery Delayed
updates.meta: Resolved / Minor / Resolved / Players who saw a delay in receiving V-Bucks should now have them available. As part of this fix, players who qualify for the Showdown Umbrella styles introduced in today's update may see them granted at a later date.

updates.title: V-Bucks Delivery Delayed
updates.meta: Identified / Minor / Resolved / We're working to fix a delay with purchased V-Bucks being granted for some players. All purchases are saved and will appear ASAP once we fix this error.

updates.title: Login and matchmaking issues in Fortnite
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / This incident has been resolved.

updates.title: Login and matchmaking issues in Fortnite
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / We're actively working on fixing the matchmaking and login errors some players may see while launching the game or while in the Lobby. We'll share an update as soon as this is fixed up.

updates.title: EAS Auth Access Token with additional claims
updates.meta: Resolved / None / Resolved / We have rolled back a change to our backend that included additional claims in the EAS Auth Access token. This change could break the login flow in some games that allocated a fixed-size buffer to the access token.

updates.title: Rocket League Matchmaking Outage
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / Matchmaking issues have been resolved. Players should now be able to queue into matches normally.

updates.title: Rocket League Matchmaking Outage
updates.meta: Identified / Major / Resolved / We're working to resolve an issue where players are unable to matchmake. We'll provide another update when this is fixed.

updates.title: Login and Matchmaking Errors
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / Log-in and Matchmaking has recovered and we're no longer seeing any server delays. We'll continue to monitor these services and address any issues that arise.

updates.title: Login and Matchmaking Errors
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / We're actively working to fix the Log-in & Matchmaking outages players are experiencing across Fortnite, Fall Guys, and Rocket League. Purchases on Epic Games Store may encounter a delay. We'll provide more info as we resolving this issue.
